/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import uno
from com.sun.star.drawing.FillStyle import SOLID

BLUE = 0x0000FF

local_ctx = uno.getComponentContext()
resolver = local_ctx.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.bridge.UnoUrlResolver', local_ctx)
ctx = resolver.resolve('uno:socket,host=localhost,port=2002;urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext')
smgr = ctx.ServiceManager
desktop = smgr.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.frame.Desktop', ctx)
doc = desktop.getCurrentComponent()
if not doc or not doc.URL.endswith('/lec17-gui-events.pptx'):
    raise SystemExit(f'Unexpected active document: {getattr(doc, \"URL\", None)}')

pages = doc.getDrawPages()
for i in range(pages.getCount()):
    page = pages.getByIndex(i)
    bg = doc.createInstance('com.sun.star.drawing.Background')
    bg.setPropertyValue('FillStyle', SOLID)
    bg.setPropertyValue('FillColor', BLUE)
    bg.setPropertyValue('FillTransparence', 0)
    page.setPropertyValue('Background', bg)
    page.setPropertyValue('IsBackgroundVisible', True)

doc.store()
print(f'Applied solid blue background to {pages.getCount()} slides and saved {doc.URL}')
PY"
